__broaden__.αὐτῆς: αὐτός — self; fem. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own works’): ’of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. governed by ἄγχι ’near, close to’: ’her’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτῆς ’close beside her’) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun ’it’ (of a ship, fem.), governed by a noun: χρεὼ ... αὐτῆς ’a need of it’
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’
__broaden__.κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’)
__broaden__.κρῖ: κρῖ — barley (indeclinable form of κριθή); neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (indeclinable, same form), subject of an existential clause: κρῖ λευκόν ’white barley’ (understood ἔνι ’is in it’)
__broaden__.κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’
__broaden__.δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. acc. sg., used collectively: ’tears’ · also elided δάκρυ’ = δάκρυα, neut. acc. pl. · also literal sg. with an attributive adjective, not collective: θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’a swelling tear’
__broaden__.μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom. pl.: ’the flocks’ · also neut. acc. pl. (same form), direct object: ἦγον ... μῆλα ’they led sheep’
__broaden__.ξανθὸς: ξανθός — fair-haired, yellow, tawny; masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Menelaus · also applied to Rhadamanthus: ξανθὸς Ῥαδάμανθυς ’fair-haired Rhadamanthus’ (the same epithet extended to a new figure)
__broaden__.τάφου: Τάφος — Taphos, home island of Mentes and the Taphians; masc. gen. sg. · also common noun τάφος — funeral, burial rites; masc. gen. sg., governed by ἀντιβολήσαις (+ gen. ’meet, come upon’): ’the funeral’
__broaden__.τρίτον: τρίτος — third; ordinal numeral, neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: τρίτον ἄνδρα ’a third man’ (as direct object)
__broaden__.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’)
__broaden__.πάροιθεν: πάροιθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also + gen., spatial: ’in front of, before’ (πάροιθεν Ὀδυσσῆος μεγάροιο ’in front of Odysseus’s hall’)
__broaden__.φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg. · also as a proper name, Φαίδιμος — Phaedimus, king of the Sidonians who gave Menelaus the silver bowl; masc. nom. sg.
__broaden__.ἐπήρετμοι: ἐπήρετμος — at the oar, seated ready to row; masc. nom. pl. · also of ships, ’fitted/equipped with oars’: νῆες ἐπήρετμοι ’oared ships’ (masc. nom. pl.)
__broaden__.ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (κακὸν … ἔργον τε ἔπος τε μελέτω ’let no evil deed or word be a care’) · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition/predicative, naming a maker: ἔργον Ἡφαίστοιο ’the work of Hephaestus’
__broaden__.ἔρυκε: ἐρύκω — hold back, detain, keep; impf. 3 sg., no augment · also pres. imper. 2 sg., in a prohibition with μή: μὴ ... ἔρυκε ’do not detain (me)!’
__broaden__.ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also plain copula, personal: ’is’ (ἀργύρεος ... ἔστιν ἅπας ’it is entirely silver’)
__broaden__.ὀνόμαζε: ἐξονομάζω — call by name, address directly; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε) · also ὀνομάζω (simple, no preverb) — name, call by name, tell the name of; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’name (him)!’ (τρίτον ἄνδρ’ ὀνόμαζε)
__broaden__.ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’)
__broaden__.ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place (distinct from ὅτε ’when’, similarly elided ὅτ’) · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — when; temporal conj.: ὅθ’ ἑὸς δόμος ἀμφεκάλυψε ’when his own house sheltered (me)’
__broaden__.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’)
__broaden__.ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’
__broaden__.ἱπποβότοιο: ἱππόβοτος — horse-pasturing, grazed by horses; adj., neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου) · also gen. of comparison after ἐπήρατος, of an implied land (fem.): μᾶλλον ἐπήρατος ἱπποβότοιο ’lovelier than a horse-pastured land’
